files.content:
<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  A restaurant menu board: category sections with DishCards in a grid, or denser menu rows in a list or a
  sectioned column. Axes: layout (sections, grid, list), prices (show, hide), density. Composes DishCard;
  section rows use MenuRow.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { Dish, FoodLabels } from "./dish-showcase.types";
  import type { DishSection } from "./restaurant-menu.types";

  export type MenuBoardProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    lead?: string;
    dishes: Dish[];
    sections: DishSection[];
    empty?: string;
    labels: FoodLabels;
    layout?: "sections" | "grid" | "list";
    prices?: "show" | "hide";
    density?: "default" | "compact";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Box from "../compose/Box.svelte";
  import Grid from "../compose/Grid.svelte";
  import List from "../compose/List.svelte";
  import Stack from "../compose/Stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../compose/Text.svelte";
  import Title from "../compose/Title.svelte";
  import DishCard from "../blocks/dish-card.svelte";
  import EmptyState from "../components/empty-state.svelte";
  import MenuRow from "../components/menu-row.svelte";
  import MenuSectionNav from "../components/menu-section-nav.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";
  import { tpl } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    lead = "",
    dishes,
    sections,
    empty = "",
    labels,
    layout = "sections",
    prices = "show",
    density = "default",
    landmarkLabel,
  }: MenuBoardProps = $props();
</script>

<SectionFrame id={id} title={title} lead={lead} density={density} landmarkLabel={landmarkLabel}>
  {#if ((sections?.length ?? 0) === 0)}
    <EmptyState icon="star" title={empty} />
  {:else}
    <Stack gap="8" align="stretch">
      {#if ((layout as string) === "sections")}
        <MenuSectionNav label={labels.sections} sections={sections} prefix={id} landmarkLabel={landmarkLabel} />
      {/if}
      <Box class="flex flex-col gap-8" data-slot="items">
        {#each sections as s (s.id)}
          <Stack
            gap={(((density as string) === "compact") ? "2" : "4")}
            id={tpl("{0}-{1}", id, s.key)}
            data-slot="menusection"
          >
            <Stack gap="0" class="border-b border-border pb-2">
              <Title as={3} size="xl" weight="bold">
                {s.title}
              </Title>
              <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
                {s.note}
              </Text>
            </Stack>
            {#if ((layout as string) === "grid")}
              <Grid cols="1-3" class="gap-4">
                {#each dishes as d (d.id)}
                  {#if (d.tag === s.key)}
                    <DishCard
                      dish={d}
                      labels={{ add: labels.add }}
                      media={(((density as string) === "compact") ? "none" : "image")}
                      prices={prices}
                      action="none"
                      density={density}
                    />
                  {/if}
                {/each}
              </Grid>
            {:else}
              <List tag="ul" class="flex flex-col">
                {#each dishes as d (d.id)}
                  {#if (d.tag === s.key)}
                    <MenuRow dish={d} prices={prices} />
                  {/if}
                {/each}
              </List>
            {/if}
          </Stack>
        {/each}
      </Box>
    </Stack>
  {/if}
</SectionFrame>
